01_intro
Tumble is a tiny farming moon. Quiet. Peaceful. Until the aliens showed up.
02_aliens
And these aliens? Total assholes. They drop pods on every road and crawl straight for the colony.
03_build
Your job is to hold the line. Tap a pad beside the road and beam down a tower.
04_laser
Laser Turrets fire fast and cheap.
05_goo
Goo Cannons glue whole crowds in place.
06_cryo
Cryo Beams slow everything down, and they can hit flyers.
07_mech
Mech Walkers launch one giant rocket fist.
08_missile
And Missile Pods rain splash damage from long range.
09_upgrade
Every alien you pop pays credits. Spend them on upgrades, then pick a specialist. Railgun or Twin Blaster. Glue Bomber or Acid Mortar. Choose wisely. It's permanent.
10_waves
Blob drones. Skitter crawlers. Armored brutes. Saucer scouts. Every wave gets meaner, so crank the speed up to eight times when you're ready.
11_terrain
Every battlefield plays differently, with jump pads, warp gates and high ground.
12_bosses
And every battle ends with a boss. The Drill Tank. The Sand Worm. The Sky Manta. And finally, the Mothership.
13_map
Ten battles across the moon. Two difficulty tiers. Earn your stars, then take on Endless mode.
14_end
Aliens and Assholes. Defend the colony. Play free in your browser.
